sections.reason: Fever with cough and breathlessness for 4 days.
sections.history: Crepitations right lower zone. SpO2 92% on room air.
sections.investigations: TLC 14,600; CRP 48 mg/L; Chest X-ray: right lower lobe consolidation.
sections.treatment: IV Ceftriaxone 1 g BD × 4 days, nebulization, oxygen for 24 h, paracetamol SOS.
sections.course: Afebrile from day 2, oxygen weaned on day 2. Improved.
sections.condition: Stable, afebrile, SpO2 98% on room air.
sections.medications: Tab. Augmentin 625 BD × 5 days; Tab. Montair LC HS × 5 days; Tab. Dolo 650 SOS.
sections.advice: Plenty of fluids, steam inhalation, avoid cold drinks.
sections.followup: Review in General Medicine OPD after 7 days with CBC.
sections.urgent: Return immediately or call the hospital if breathlessness, high fever or chest pain.

sections.investigations: Hb 11.4 g/dL; blood group B+; USG normal.
sections.procedures: Normal vaginal delivery with episiotomy. Live female baby 3.1 kg.
sections.medications: Iron and calcium tablets × 3 months; Tab. Dolo 650 SOS.
sections.followup: Review after 6 weeks; baby vaccination as per schedule.
sections.urgent: Come immediately for heavy bleeding, fever or foul-smelling discharge.

sections.reason: Fever, body ache and headache for 3 days.
sections.investigations: NS1 antigen positive. Platelets 98,000 → 1,42,000 at discharge.
sections.advice: Oral fluids 3 litres/day. Avoid painkillers other than paracetamol.
sections.urgent: Return for bleeding, abdominal pain, vomiting or drowsiness.

sections.procedures: Closed reduction under sedation, below-elbow cast.
